name: spreadsheets
description: Real spreadsheet production: one formatted sheet, live formulas and a separate chart.

commands.name: xlsx
commands.template: Create one workbook for: {input}. Pass the title and the rows. The first row is the header. A total is a formula. A percent is written as 12% so it is stored as a fraction. Then verify the file.

commands.name: model
commands.template: Build one sheet for: {input}. Put inputs, assumptions and outputs in labeled rows on that sheet. Totals and links are formulas such as =SUM(B2:B10) and =B2*C2. State every assumption in its own cell. Then verify the file.

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Clean a table and keep the raw copy
commands.template: Clean the table described by: {input}. Write the raw rows to one workbook and the cleaned rows to a second workbook. Each workbook has one sheet. State every change. Then verify both files.

tools.name: create_xlsx
tools.description: Creates a real Excel file (.xlsx): styled header, typed cells, safe formulas, number formats, auto filter, frozen header and a bold total row. Cell values starting with = are written as live formulas when they are regular spreadsheet formulas (=SUM(B2:B10), =B2*C2, =IF(...)); unsafe payloads stay inert text. Percentages, currencies (EUR, USD, CHF, GBP) and ISO dates are recognised automatically. Pass the data as rows (JSON array of arrays or CSV text). Use this for tables, evaluations, lists.

title.description: Title shown as the heading (also the file-name base).

data.description: Rows as JSON array of arrays or CSV text (first row = header)

filename.description: Optional output file name (a bare name, not a path); the result line names the finished file.

formats.description: Optional column formats: an object keyed by header name or 1-based column index, or a list by column position. Each value is a format code or one of currency, percent, integer, decimal, date.

tools.name: generate_chart
tools.description: Creates a data chart (bar/line/pie) as an SVG image in Ephe design. Use this when the user wants to visualize data. The image appears in the chat automatically. theme='light' (default) matches a PDF page; theme='dark' for the studio surface. For bar/line pass series=[{name, values}, …] to draw several groups or lines with a legend, and embed the result in a PDF with a whole line ![chart](/absolute/path.svg).

chart_type.description: Chart kind: one of bar, line, pie.

title.description: Chart title shown above the plot.

values.description: Numeric values, same length as labels. Required unless series is given.

color.description: Optional #rrggbb accent colour for a single series.

series.description: Optional multi-series data for bar/line: a list of {name, values}; labels and every series must have equal length.

changelog: 1.2.0 - the sheet and chart tools ask the host. The rows, the labels and the path stay out of the bridge row. The create_xlsx schema takes no path. 1.1.0 - DoD pass: skill pack with two examples, commands, changelog and README entry.
